author: TechAIDailyNews
text: Skild AI has introduced S1, a robotics foundation model designed to learn new tasks from one video demonstration without fine-tuning or post-training; the post says it can execute unseen tasks lasting up to 10 minutes.

author: heetezition
text: Post claims one million hours of action-free video reduced measured robot-data requirements from about 5,900 teleoperation hours to 28, referring to Perceptron Isaac 0.5.

author: TimLi_DR
text: Commentary on Figure's Index: the author says Figure plans to spend more than $1B on data and compute over 12 months, arguing that general-purpose robotics needs diverse real-world human data. The quoted Figure post says it has 264,000+ app downloads and 16 million uploaded videos.
